description: This Java class defines enumeration mappings for holiday status types and reschedule types within the Fineract project's organization holiday service module. It provides static methods to convert integer IDs or enum instances into EnumOptionData objects that encapsulate information about each enumeration value.

classes.name: HolidayEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert holiday status and reschedule types to EnumOptionData representations.

methods.name: holidayStatusType(int id)
methods.description: Converts an integer ID to an EnumOptionData representing the holiday status type.

methods.name: holidayStatusType(HolidayStatusType type)
methods.description: Converts a HolidayStatusType enum value into an EnumOptionData.

methods.name: rescheduleType(int id)
methods.description: Converts an integer ID to an EnumOptionData representing the reschedule type.

methods.name: rescheduleType(RescheduleType type)
methods.description: Converts a RescheduleType enum value into an EnumOptionData.
